answer.rationale: The mandate requires 18% cost reduction; the incumbent refuses to reopen pricing; the low-cost vendor's quote meets the target alone. Memory_c2 documents successful prior migration to this vendor with fast onboarding and accurate invoicing. Memory_c3 shows second-source strategy mitigated constraint risk previously. However, switching as the sole decision creates delivery risk given 94% line utilization and no buffer. Verifying memory_c2 (execution quality of prior switch) and memory_c4 (negotiation recovery potential) to confirm the incumbent cannot be moved on price and that the vendor switch has demonstrated reliability. The 14-day contract expiration and mandate deadline compress the decision window. Standard experiment scale applies because this is the primary supply contract with measurable cost and delivery tracking already in place.
